A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MambaVision work and provide readable text, equations, figures, and tables. v1 ends with references; v2 includes readable Appendices G-J. The retained material can be matched despite substantial layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original MambaVision classification, detection, segmentation, and architectural-ablation results in Tables 1-5.

after.justification: v2 retains original empirical results and adds ImageNet-21K scaling experiments, window-size experiments, and attention visualizations.

M1.justification: The core four-stage backbone, two-branch MambaVision mixer, concatenation, and placement of self-attention in later layers are retained. L3 extends model scale, while the new architecture table supplies configuration details; neither establishes a new algorithmic component or procedure.

E1.justification: v2 adds actual ImageNet-21K pretraining, substantially expanding training-data coverage beyond v1's ImageNet-1K experiments. ImageNet-1K classification, COCO detection/instance segmentation, and ADE20K semantic segmentation remain.

E2.justification: Table 1 adds ResNetV2-101, SiMBA-S/B, EfficientFormer-L1/L3/L7, Visformer-S, and additional Twins, DeiT, CrossViT, and NextViT variants. Swin-B is removed from that table, Twins-SVT-S is removed from Table 3, and Table 2 drops the separate Mask R-CNN comparison group while retaining Cascade Mask R-CNN comparisons.

E3.justification: v2 introduces ImageNet-21K pretraining/fine-tuning experiments with larger configurations, including the 739.6M-parameter L3 and 256/512 resolutions, plus window-size comparisons. The stated ImageNet-1K learning rate changes from 0.005 in v1 Section 4 to 0.004 in v2 Appendix I, and the standalone Mask R-CNN 3x benchmark is removed. These reported changes do not establish that retained experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: v2 adds data/model/resolution scaling analysis in Figure 4, window-size sensitivity and throughput analysis in Appendix G/Table S.1, and attention case studies in Figures 5 and S.1. The original token-mixer and hybrid-placement ablations remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The added experiments continue the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: v2 adds scaling results, including ImageNet-21K-pretrained L3 Top-1 accuracies of 87.3% at 256 resolution and 88.1% at 512; these use new training conditions. In retained Cascade comparisons, T/S box AP changes from 51.0/52.1 to 51.1/52.3, with additional AP-column revisions. MambaVision-T ADE20K mIoU falls from 46.6 to 46.0 in Tables 3 and 4, while the original MambaVision ImageNet-1K rows remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 3.2.1 corrects the dimensions of B and its discretized counterpart from 1 x M to M x 1, making them consistent with the state equations. The remaining derivations are retained; Appendix Equation 9 repeats the existing attention formula.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction retain the central hybrid-backbone and accuracy-throughput claims. The conclusion adds successful ImageNet-21K scaling and performance matching SOTA models, while Section 5.3 introduces a priority claim for successful Mamba-based vision scaling to ImageNet-21K.

C2.justification: v2 interprets attention maps as evidence of semantic localization, fine-grained feature recognition, and relationships between scene elements in Section 5.3 and Appendix J. It also adds a rationale for the window-size efficiency tradeoff and arguments for applicability to industrial and large-scale training.

D1.justification: Table S.2 newly documents channels, block counts, and attention heads; other disclosures include default 14/7 windows, the COCO crop resolution, and 1x schedules for COCO ablations. Conversely, v1's cosine schedule, warmup/cooldown, weight decays, and downstream learning rates are omitted, although several other settings move to Appendix I. Algorithm 1 corrects an initialization syntax error; the code-access URL remains unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 broadens its positioning from ViT/Mamba discussions to four architecture families, adding CNN and Conv-Transformer discussions and a substantive SiMBA comparison. New references include AlexNet, EfficientFormer, SiMBA, Visformer, NextViT, DeiT III, and ResNet Strikes Back; LeViT, XCiT, LAMB, and AdamW references disappear. The ImageNet-21K scaling priority claim further extends the novelty positioning.

P1.justification: Existing related-work, downstream-results, ablation, and conclusion passages undergo extensive rewriting. Related work is reorganized into four families, and training documentation is redistributed between Section 4 and the new appendix structure.

P2.justification: v2 adopts a two-column layout and relocates/resizes retained figures and tables. It adds Figures 4, 5, and S.1 and Tables S.1-S.2, while Table 5 gains separate pattern and parameter-count columns. These are substantial display changes beyond numerical updates.

improvement.justification: ImageNet-21K scaling, broader comparisons, and the controlled window-size study strengthen the empirical assessment beyond v1. The gains are tempered by omitted training settings and new documentation inconsistencies: Table S.2 contains block counts conflicting with the stated equal Mamba/attention split, and Table 4's revised 46.0 mIoU leaves the claimed +0.9 gain inconsistent with its 45.7 comparator. Overall, the added diagnostic evidence provides a limited net improvement.
